name: Meeting
agenda_text:
SPECIAL MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL
AND THE CITY COUNCIL AS THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE
REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - OCTOBER 11, 2012 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
A G E N D A
Public input will be allowed on all Agenda items at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered.
1.
Call to Order
2.
Invocation
3.
Pledge of Allegiance
4.
Roll Call
5.
Presentations
6.
Public Comments and Suggestions
CONSENT CALENDAR
7.
Approval of Registers of Demands
A.
City of Cerritos dated October 11, 2012. (COUNCIL)
approve the Register of Demands dated October 11, 2012 in the total amount of $4,065,895.84.
B.
Successor Agency dated October 11, 2012. (SUCCESSOR AGENCY)
approve the Register of Demands dated October 11, 2012 in the total amount of $279,992.50.
8.
Approval of the Treasurer's Report for the period ending August 31, 2012. (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY)
approve the Treasurer's Report for the period ending August 31, 2012.
9.
Approval of Minutes
A.
City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting of September 27, 2012. (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY)
approve the City Council/Successor Agency Regular meeting minutes of September 27, 2012.
10.
Resolutions for consideration and adoption. Reading of resolutions waived and resolutions adopted.
A.
Consideration to waive reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, CALLING AND GIVING NOTICE OF THE HOLDING OF A GENERAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION ON TUESDAY, MARCH 5, 2013, FOR THE ELECTION OF CERTAIN OFFICERS AS REQUIRED BY THE PROVISIONS OF THE CHARTER. (COUNCIL)
waive reading of and adopt a resolution calling and giving notice of the March 5, 2012 election entitled: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, CALLING AND GIVING NOTICE OF THE HOLDING OF A GENERAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION ON TUESDAY, MARCH 5, 2013, FOR THE ELECTION OF CERTAIN OFFICERS AS REQUIRED BY THE PROVISION OF THE CHARTER.
B.
Consideration to waive reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, REQUESTING THE BOARD OF SUPERVISORS OF THE COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES TO RENDER SPECIFIED SERVICES TO THE CITY RELATING TO THE CONDUCT OF A GENERAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION TO BE HELD IN THE CITY ON TUESDAY, MARCH 5, 2013. (COUNCIL)
waive reading of and adopt a resolution entitled: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, REQUESTING THE BOARD OF SUPERVISORS OF THE COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES TO RENDER SPECIFIED SERVICES TO THE CITY RELATING TO THE CONDUCT OF A GENERAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION TO BE HELD IN THE CITY ON TUESDAY, MARCH 5, 2013.
C.
Consideration to waive reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, ADOPTING REGULATIONS FOR CANDIDATES FOR ELECTIVE OFFICE PERTAINING TO CANDIDATE'S STATEMENTS SUBMITTED TO THE VOTERS AT AN ELECTION TO BE HELD ON TUESDAY, MARCH 5, 2013. (COUNCIL)
waive reading of and adopt a resolution setting forth regulations pertaining to candidate's statements for the March 5, 2013 election entitled: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, ADOPTING REGULATIONS FOR CANDIDATES FOR ELECTIVE OFFICE PERTAINING TO CANDIDATE'S STATEMENTS SUBMITTED TO THE VOTERS AT AN ELECTION TO BE HELD ON TUESDAY, MARCH 5, 2013.
End of Consent Calendar
11.
Public Hearings
A.
A REQUEST BY APPLICANT GOODWILL SOLAC, 800 WEST PACIFIC COAST HIGHWAY, LONG BEACH, CA 90806, ON BEHALF OF PROPERTY OWNER SYSTEM II, LLC, FOR APPROVAL OF A CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT FOR A GOODWILL STORE WITH A BUSINESS OPERATION THAT INCLUDES RETAIL SALES AND A DONATION DROP-OFF CENTER. THE SUBJECT PROPERTY IS LOCATED AT 17518 CARMENITA ROAD, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, 90703 AND IS ZONED NEIGHBORHOOD COMMERCIAL (CN) (APN 7027-020-034). (COUNCIL)
CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT 2012-2*
*PURSUANT TO SECTION 15301 OF THE CALIFORNIA ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY ACT (CEQA), THIS PROJECT IS CATEGORICALLY EXEMPT.
approve
Option 1: Approve the CUP application as modified and presented in Attachment B-1 with Revised Conditions of Approval provided as Attachment B-6 of this staff report; or
Option 2: Deny the CUP application; or
Option 3: Refer the CUP application as modified back to the Planning Commission for a review of the applicant's revised proposal and present the Planning Commission's findings to the City Council at a later date for consideration and final City Council action.
12.
New and Old Business
A.
Designation of Voting Delegate and Alternate(s) for the National League of Cities 2012 Annual Business Meeting to be held on December 1, 2012. (COUNCIL)
discuss participation in the National League of Cities (NLC) 2012 Annual Business Meeting and designate a voting delegate and alternate from among the Councilmembers who will be in attendance.
B.
Consideration and award of contract for citywide sidewalk, curb and gutter repairs in the City of Cerritos, Bid No. 1150-13. (COUNCIL)
1. Award a contract for the citywide sidewalk, curb and gutter repairs in the City of Cerritos, Bid No. 1150-13, to T.A. Pointer Enterprises, Inc. in the amount of $45,000 and reject all other bids; and
2. Authorize the inclusion of Additive Alternate B in the amount of $16,500 as part of the citywide sidewalk, curb and gutter repair contract.
C.
Independent Accountant's report on applying agreed-upon procedures relating to the due diligence review in accordance with AB 1484 applied to the Successor Agency Low- and Moderate-Income Housing Fund. (SUCCESSOR AGENCY)
receive and file the report.
13.
Legislative Items
A.
Report on Pending Legislation.
B.
Action to support or oppose specific legislation pending in the California Legislature or pending in the California Governor's Office for signature.
14.
City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Report on Meetings
15.
Adjournment
